title: fragariastrum elatior
intro: Fragariastrum elatior, commonly known as Wild Strawberry, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragariastrum elatior include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
